story.iWant: to install all required dependencies for the project
story.soThat: I can start building features immediately

tasks.task: Create and activate virtual environment (AC: #1) Run `python -m venv venv` to create venv Activate venv: `source venv/bin/activate` (macOS/Linux) or `venv\Scripts\activate` (Windows) Verify Python version: `python --version` (must be 3.10+) Document activation steps in README.md

Install core runtime dependencies (AC: #2) Install `typer` (CLI framework with type hints) Install `pydantic` (runtime validation, data models) Install `httpx` (async HTTP client with connection pooling) Install `pandas` (data manipulation and analysis) Install `rich` (terminal formatting and tables) Install `python-dotenv` (environment variable loading) Install `openai` (OpenAI SDK for GPT access) Install `tenacity` (retry logic with exponential backoff) Install `beautifulsoup4` (web scraping for ESPN/FlashScore)
Install development dependencies (AC: #3) Install `pytest` (testing framework) Install `pytest-asyncio` (async test support) Install `mypy` (static type checking) Install `ruff` (fast Python linter)

Generate and validate requirements.txt (AC: #4) Run `pip freeze > requirements.txt` to capture pinned versions Document which packages are core vs dev (comments in file) Verify no conflicting dependency versions Test clean install: `pip install -r requirements.txt` from fresh venv

Validate all imports (AC: #6) Create `/tests/verify_imports.py` validation script Import each package: typer, pydantic, httpx, pandas, rich, openai, tenacity, bs4 Run: `python tests/verify_imports.py` → all imports succeed No ImportError or version conflicts

Documentation updates (AC: #5, #7) Update README.md with Python version requirement (3.10+) Add "Installation" section with venv setup steps Document difference between dev and runtime dependencies Include troubleshooting section for common install issues

Validation (AC: all) Run `pip list` and verify all required packages present with correct versions Run `python -c "import bet_bot"` successfully Run `pytest --version` to verify pytest available Run `mypy --version` to verify type checker available Run import validation script without errors

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Virtual environment activation documented in README

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Core Dependencies for bet-bot project including httpx (async HTTP client), pydantic (data validation), tenacity (retry logic), and beautifulsoup4 (web scraping). Python 3.10+ required for modern syntax and type hints.

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Development tools: pytest for unit/integration tests, pytest-asyncio for async test support, ruff for linting, mypy for type checking. Minimum 80% code coverage required with 100% coverage for critical paths.

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Graceful error handling for API failures, data quality issues, and OpenAI failures. Retry logic with exponential backoff using tenacity. Dependency versions tuned for stability and async compatibility.

doc.title: Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Python 3.10+ required for modern syntax and type hints. Package management via pip with requirements.txt for pinned versions ensuring reproducibility. Environment variables managed via python-dotenv.

doc.title: Project Development Guidelines
doc.snippet: HTTP Client Architecture using httpx (NOT requests/aiohttp). Connection pooling with max_connections=100, keepalive=20. HTTP/2 enabled. Tenacity for retry logic with exponential backoff (2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s). Pydantic v2 for data validation.

doc.title: Data Dictionary
doc.snippet: Pydantic models define data structures: Team, Fixture, AIAnalysis, MarketAnalysis, Pick. Models include field validators and JSON serialization support. Strict validation enforces data quality.

standards.paragraph: Testing in bet-bot follows pytest framework with asyncio support via pytest-asyncio plugin. Tests are organized in tests/ directory with unit/ and integration/ subdirectories. Minimum 80% code coverage required for all code, with 100% coverage target for critical paths (EV calculation, edge detection, confidence scoring). Type checking enforced via mypy with strict mode. Linting via ruff with strict configuration. All development dependencies (pytest, pytest-cov, mypy, ruff) installed in venv alongside runtime dependencies.
